Die Grotesk fonts are excluded: their embedded Klim license requires separate rights. Named CSS font stacks fall back to system fonts. Paper Mono is distributed separately under SIL OFL1.1; its notice accompanies the font.

Third-party npm dependencies retain their original package licenses. Orama packages use Apache2.0; clipboard-copy, scroll-into-view-if-needed, Starry Night, Tailwind and PostCSS tooling use MIT. Starry Night grammar files retain their upstream notices.

## Syntax engine and grammar notices

The supported Svelte grammar is distributed by Starry Night 3.10.0 from sebastinez/svelte-atom (MIT). Original JSON grammar is deferred: its declared Nixinova/NovaGrammars ISC notice could not be located; no JSON grammar payload is bundled. Source grammar metadata is retained for a readable plain-text fallback.
